meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Exchange rate of the rupee vis-a-vis the SDR, US$, £, € and ¥ (DBIE report 1374)
meta.coverage: The rupee against the SDR and the major currencies, monthly average and end of month, since 1992
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1374. Rupees per unit (yen per 100). The UAE dirham and Indonesian rupiah were added as reference currencies in 2026 and have only a few months.
